recorded_model_response.review_markdown:
## Summary

The new transport canary test cannot pass as written: it compares against redaction placeholder tokens instead of real credential values, which breaks the TypeScript assertions.

## Findings

- **Blocker** (tests/transport-canary.test.ts:12) — the test file commits sanitizer placeholder tokens as credential literals.

## Recommendation

Request changes: the test must compare against real credential values, not redaction artifacts.
